description: This file defines the interface 'JsonPatch' along with its nested enum 'Operation' and class 'JsonFields'. It specifies the structure and behavior for JSON Patch modifications, including creation, representation, and supported operations (add, remove, replace).

classes.name: JsonPatch
classes.description: Interface defining a JSON Patch, which can be used to specify modifications on JSON objects, including creating new patches and accessing their components.

classes.name: JsonPatch.Operation
classes.description: Enumeration of supported JSON Patch operation types: add, remove, replace.

classes.name: JsonPatch.JsonFields
classes.description: Immutable class containing definitions for JSON fields used in JSON Patch objects.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new JSON Patch instance with specified operation, path, and value.

methods.name: getOperation
methods.description: Returns the operation type of the JSON Patch.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the path within the JSON object where the patch operation is applied.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the value associated with the patch, if any.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Returns the JSON object representation of the patch.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a minimal JSON string representation of the patch.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Converts a string to an Operation enum value if possible.
